description: Attested screenshot evidence validated by lint-render.mjs. Measurements must be produced by an independent reviewer or renderer; Node does not infer them from image bytes alone.

S1.name: Blocker
S1.definition: User cannot make the decision, is likely to make a wrong one, an accessibility gate fails, or a destructive action is unsafely presented.

S2.name: Major
S2.definition: Decision is possible but materially slower or error-prone.

S3.name: Minor
S3.definition: Adds friction or inconsistency without threatening the decision.

S4.name: Polish
S4.definition: Craft refinement with no functional impact.

rules.name: Exactly one focal point
rules.check: Blur the view 8-12px. Exactly one region remains dominant.
rules.fix: Raise device points on the intended P0; remove points from competitors. Subtract before adding.

rules.name: Proximity ratio
rules.check: For each zone, gap inside must be at most half of gap between.
rules.fix: Reduce intra-group gaps or increase inter-group gaps to reach a 2:1 ratio.

rules.name: Declared viewport
rules.check: A7 states a target viewport. P0 and all P1 fit without scrolling.
rules.fix: Declare the viewport and verify above-the-fold content.

rules.name: Status outranks accent
rules.check: Where a danger state and a primary action are both visible, the danger state reads first.
rules.fix: Do not fight status color; verify the status deserves the priority.

rules.name: Grayscale test
rules.check: Render in grayscale. Hierarchy and status meaning survive.
rules.fix: Re-encode hue-dependent hierarchy with size, weight, position, space.

rules.name: Five-second test
rules.check: After 5 seconds of exposure, the single most important element and its state are correctly identified.
rules.fix: Strengthen the P0 and reduce competing emphasis.

rules.name: Value dominates label
rules.check: In a metric block the value has larger size and stronger color than its label.

rules.name: Whitespace budget
rules.check: Negative space is 30 to 40 percent for strategic and analytical, 20 to 30 percent for operational.

rules.name: Priority holds across breakpoints
rules.check: Reflow order equals tier order at every breakpoint.
rules.fix: Define one priority order and reflow against it.
